scripts.server:dev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$jh=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('JAVA_HOME','Machine'); if($jh){$env:JAVA_HOME=$jh.TrimEnd('\')}; $env:Path=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine')+';'+[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); Set-Location server; cmd /c mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run"
scripts.server:build: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$jh=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('JAVA_HOME','Machine'); if($jh){$env:JAVA_HOME=$jh.TrimEnd('\')}; $env:Path=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine')+';'+[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); Set-Location server; cmd /c mvnw.cmd -q package -DskipTests"
